java: TFunctionImpl.addBody stores each procedure body line as its original StringLocated, including its LineLocation.
TFunctionImpl.executeProcedureInternal sends that stored body list to TContext.executeLines, so procedure-emitted plain lines keep definition-body ownership.

CodeIteratorProcedure consumes procedure declarations and body collection before returning later outer iterator lines, so ordinary lines after a call are still the original top-level StringLocated values.
TContext.addPlain and applyFunctionsAndVariablesInternal add transformed plain lines back to resultList with the input StringLocated location, including split newline results.
BlockUml constructs TimLoader over the extracted rawSource stream without replacing line locations, which supports the account's separate preamble-backed absolute location domain.
rust: BufferedLine stores both raw_source_line and diagram source_line when a procedure body is collected.
process_buffered_line restores the stored source_line through source_line_override while evaluating procedure body lines.
try_function_call marks subsequent caller-file lines with explicit origins after any top-level procedure emits output, so later lines no longer inherit flattened vector positions.
current_diagram_source_line preserves zero-based first-line @start numbering while keeping absolute positions for extracted blocks whose @start line is greater than one.
